title: Quarterly runway: scenario-driven prioritization & contingency playbook for Hosted API + Model Catalog
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: create a compact, repeatable quarterly runway playbook that teams (PM/Eng/Design) can use to prioritize Hosted API endpoints and model catalog changes across three demand scenarios (conservative / baseline / surge).

Scope: hosted API product surface + model catalog lineup decisions that require cross-functional gating (SLA, capacity, cost-per-token impact, regression risk). Outputs: a decision matrix, canary windows & rollback criteria, capacity hedging rules, and a stakeholder cadence for on-call and launch readiness.

Goals:
- Give Product and Eng a deterministic way to choose which models and endpoint features land in each quarter lane.
- Surface cost/latency tradeoffs for customer cohorts and map them to rollout lanes.
- Create contingency triggers and pre-authorized fallback plans for capacity/latency incidents.

Success metrics:
- Reduce ad-hoc model rollbacks by 50% vs previous quarter.
- 90% of model rotations have predefined fallback variants and runbook steps.
- Roadmap sign-off cycle time reduced to 7 days for prioritized items.
acceptance_criteria: Decision matrix documented and reviewed by Eng + SRE + Growth
Canary schedule template with automatic rollback criteria added to Console runbooks
Capacity hedge thresholds and escalation contacts integrated with capacity-dashboard (link in comments)
Stakeholder cadence established: weekly runway sync + biweekly risk review

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Model quality regressions when swapping to quantized variants. Mitigation: require automated eval suite (subset of production prompts) and manual sign-off for high-impact endpoints. Risk: Capacity surprise during marketing-driven surge. Mitigation: pre-authorized burst capacity lane and throttling policy with customer notifications.
